text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, we're scheduled to do a different 
kind of training than usual.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Preparation of the racewear is complete. 
All that's left is to run."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see how much my running changes in 
this outfit... I'm going to test it on the 
track right away."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Kh... Heh...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaa! Brian-senpai is so gorgeouuus! Is 
she running in that outfit!?

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Looking ready for a GⅠ race! Excuse 
me! Look over here, please, give us a 
look~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... Always making such a racket.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With an eye on the GⅠ race, I thought 
practicing in her racing silks would 
help... but it seems to have backfired."
choice_data_list: I'll go give them a quick heads-up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's not needed. ...Let's run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —I'll shut them up myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...âHaaah!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What incredible acceleration?! Hey, 
keep her in the frame somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! I can feel her sheer 
fighting spirit reaching all the way over 
here—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: —It got... through...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Phew... How was the time? ...Hey, what are 
you spacing out for?
choice_data_list: Because it really got so quiet...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Slipping my arms through these sleeves 
gets my heart racing. Perhaps it's the 
horseshoe motifs adorning the outfit that 
make me feel this way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
All you hear while running is your own 
heartbeat... and the ragged breathing of 
the prey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No matter what noise is made, no matter 
how close their presence draws—it will not 
reach me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'll blow past them with these legs and 
shut them all up.
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the actual race, 
too.
Ooh, that sends shivers down my spine...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go for one more rep. I haven't 
run anywhere near enough yet.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's run too! Seeing them so serious, 
I can't just stand still!"

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Mute the shutter sound on that camera. 
We're gonna focus and capture them... 
running with everything they've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Narita Brian blowing everyone 
away with her run, we were able to train 
in peace.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
I see, an electrifying run! This'll make 
for a great headline~.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Even that exasperated face is so 
gor... geous...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... I don't have time to deal with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to run alone. Feel free to sit 
there being spineless, the lot of you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly apologized to the furious 
Narita Brian and pulled myself together...
